g.text: layer pattern, bars every @ 600 along the path

svg.text: Detail D1: eave, roof to wall
(1) Roof outer layer 80, printed with the rest of the piece;
outside it the insulation 100 (dotted) and the outer layer 30
(dark).
(2) Zig-zag lattice 80 in a 160 zone; it touches the outer layer
and layer 2 every @ 600; the cells between are open air pockets
for ventilation.
(3) Layer 2, 80: printed bead that curves to leave a pocket for
the bar.
(4) Inner layer 1, 80, room side. Layers 1 and 2 together are the
structural leaf: 160 at the base, 80 at the crown (layer 2 ends).
(5*) Rebar pocket Ø55 in the leaf, grouted after placing. Roof
bars R Ø12 every @ 600 along the path.
(6*) Knee bars B Ø12 every @ 600, one continuous bar over the
eave: 1100 down the wall pocket (laps wall bars A), through the
solid base, 650 up the roof.
(7*) Ring bars Ø12 in the pocket zone every 300, above the solid
base.
(8) Solid base of the roof: over the first 300 (vertical) above
the eave the 160 zone between the printed layers is filled with
cast concrete instead of the open lattice; wall bars A hook into
it. Replaces the ring beam.
(9) Buttress 400 wide, 1000 from the inner face (600 beyond the
wall): printed formwork (80 end cap shown) filled with cast
concrete; top flush with the roof base at +2.50.
(10*) Wall 400 printed, same pattern as the roof; wall bars A Ø16
run from the footing up into the solid base and end in a 160 hook
(assumed).
* = assumed, to confirm
